package practicetaskclient

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

type Client struct {
	BaseURL       string
	InternalToken string
	HTTPClient    *http.Client
}

func (c Client) GetTask(ctx context.Context, taskID string) (*answer.TaskMetadata, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}

	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/runtime/tasks/%s", strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/"), taskID)
	values := make([]string, 0, 2)
	if userID := answer.TaskLookupUserIDFromContext(ctx); userID != "" {
		values = append(values, "user_id="+userID)
	}
	if answerID := answer.TaskLookupAnswerIDFromContext(ctx); answerID != "" {
		values = append(values, "answer_id="+answerID)
	}
	if len(values) > 0 {
		endpoint += "?" + strings.Join(values, "&")
	}

	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, endpoint, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if c.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusConflict {
		var payload struct {
			Message string `json:"message"`
		}
		_ = json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&payload)
		return &answer.TaskMetadata{
			ID:                     taskID,
			Status:                 domain.TaskStatusActive,
			Type:                   10,
			TaskKind:               "practice_task_milestone",
			ExecutionMode:          "BROWSER_PREVIEW",
			EvaluationMode:         "AUTO",
			UIMode:                 "PREVIEW",
			SubmissionMode:         "SNAPSHOT",
			RequiresSandbox:        true,
			ExposesPreview:         true,
			SupportsLiveValidation: true,
			Locked:                 true,
			BlockingReason:         payload.Message,
			IsPracticeTaskRuntime:  true,
		}, nil
	}
	if resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("practice task runtime error: %s", resp.Status)
	}

	var payload struct {
		ID                     string          `json:"id"`
		LessonID               string          `json:"lesson_id"`
		CourseID               string          `json:"course_id"`
		CourseVersionID        string          `json:"course_version_id"`
		Title                  string          `json:"title"`
		Description            string          `json:"description"`
		Status                 int             `json:"status"`
		Type                   int16           `json:"type"`
		TaskKind               string          `json:"task_kind"`
		CodeStructureTypeCode  string          `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
		CodeStructure          json.RawMessage `json:"code_structure"`
		ComposeConfig          json.RawMessage `json:"compose_config"`
		ExecutionMode          string          `json:"execution_mode"`
		EvaluationMode         string          `json:"evaluation_mode"`
		UIMode                 string          `json:"ui_mode"`
		SubmissionMode         string          `json:"submission_mode"`
		RequiresSandbox        bool            `json:"requires_sandbox"`
		ExposesPreview         bool            `json:"exposes_preview"`
		ExposesTerminal        bool            `json:"exposes_terminal"`
		SupportsLiveValidation bool            `json:"supports_live_validation"`
		AllowedErrorsCount     int             `json:"allowed_errors_count"`
		Access                 struct {
			Status          string `json:"status"`
			Locked          bool   `json:"locked"`
			BlockingReason  string `json:"blocking_reason"`
			CurrentTaskID   string `json:"current_task_id"`
			CurrentLessonID string `json:"current_lesson_id"`
		} `json:"access"`
	}
	if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if payload.CourseID == "" {
		payload.CourseID = payload.CourseVersionID
	}

	return &answer.TaskMetadata{
		ID:                     payload.ID,
		LessonID:               payload.LessonID,
		CourseID:               payload.CourseID,
		Title:                  payload.Title,
		Description:            payload.Description,
		Status:                 payload.Status,
		Type:                   payload.Type,
		TaskKind:               payload.TaskKind,
		CodeStructureType:      payload.CodeStructureTypeCode,
		CodeStructure:          payload.CodeStructure,
		ComposeConfig:          payload.ComposeConfig,
		AllowedErrorsCount:     payload.AllowedErrorsCount,
		ExecutionMode:          payload.ExecutionMode,
		EvaluationMode:         payload.EvaluationMode,
		UIMode:                 payload.UIMode,
		SubmissionMode:         payload.SubmissionMode,
		RequiresSandbox:        payload.RequiresSandbox,
		ExposesPreview:         payload.ExposesPreview,
		ExposesTerminal:        payload.ExposesTerminal,
		SupportsLiveValidation: payload.SupportsLiveValidation,
		Completed:              payload.Access.Status == "passed" || payload.Access.Status == "skipped",
		Readonly:               payload.Access.Status == "passed" || payload.Access.Status == "skipped",
		Locked:                 payload.Access.Locked,
		Current:                payload.Access.Status == "available" || payload.Access.Status == "in_progress" || payload.Access.Status == "failed",
		BlockingReason:         payload.Access.BlockingReason,
		RedirectLessonID:       payload.Access.CurrentLessonID,
		RedirectTaskID:         payload.Access.CurrentTaskID,
		IsPracticeTaskRuntime:  true,
	}, nil
}

func (c Client) GetCourseStructure(context.Context, string) (*answer.CourseStructure, error) {
	return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
}

func (c Client) BindAnswer(ctx context.Context, userID, taskID, answerID, sandboxID string, previewURL *string) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"user_id":     userID,
		"sandbox_id":  sandboxID,
		"preview_url": previewURL,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/runtime/tasks/%s/answers/%s/bind", strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/"), taskID, answerID)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if c.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
	if resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
		return fmt.Errorf("practice task bind error: %s", resp.Status)
	}
	return nil
}

func (c Client) FinalizeAnswer(ctx context.Context, answerID string, passed bool, rawResult map[string]any, fileStorageID *string, sandboxID, previewURL *string) error {
	if strings.TrimSpace(c.BaseURL) == "" {
		return nil
	}
	rawResultJSON, err := json.Marshal(rawResult)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
		"status":          statusNameFromPassed(passed),
		"passed":          passed,
		"raw_result":      json.RawMessage(rawResultJSON),
		"file_storage_id": fileStorageID,
		"sandbox_id":      sandboxID,
		"preview_url":     previewURL,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	endpoint := fmt.Sprintf("%s/internal/runtime/answers/%s/finalize", strings.TrimRight(c.BaseURL, "/"), answerID)
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodPost, endpoint, bytes.NewReader(body))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	if c.InternalToken != "" {
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", c.InternalToken)
	}
	client := c.HTTPClient
	if client == nil {
		client = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	resp, err := client.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
	if resp.StatusCode >= 400 {
		return fmt.Errorf("practice task finalize error: %s", resp.Status)
	}
	return nil
}

func statusNameFromPassed(passed bool) string {
	if passed {
		return "passed"
	}
	return "failed"
}
